default.$description: Body text and headings. Must reach 4.5:1 on every background role, and 9:1 on bg-default (the image focus ring relies on it).

secondary.$description: Supporting text, such as quotes and intros. Must reach 4.5:1 on bg-default and bg-secondary.

tertiary.$description: The least prominent text, such as captions and meta. Page background only: must reach 4.5:1 on bg-default. On a band, use fg-secondary.

secondary.$description: Bands and panels set off from the page, such as FeaturedSection.

default.$description: Dividers and control outlines. Must reach 3:1 against bg-default.
The brand mark: fills, rules, and highlights.

fg.$description: Accent-coloured text and links on bg-default. Must reach 4.5:1 there.

onAccent.$description: Text on an accent-default fill. Must reach 4.5:1 on it.

bg.$description: A soft accent surface, such as a featured band. fg-default must reach 4.5:1 on it.
Primary button fill. Defaults to accent-default. Must reach 3:1 against bg-default.

fg.$description: Primary button text. Must reach 4.5:1 on button-primary-bg.
Secondary button text and border. Must reach 4.5:1 on bg-default.

background.$description: The wash over images behind text, at opacity-overlay.

bg.$description: Text selection highlight. fg-default must reach 4.5:1 on it.

focusRing.$description: Keyboard focus indicator. Must reach 3:1 against bg-default, bg-secondary, bg-tertiary, and accent-bg.

filter.$description: Filter applied to images, such as dimming in dark mode.

width.$description: Default border width for controls and dividers.
